facts.text: Forget the rules for one night, Scott. Eat something, then show them your own steps.
facts.why: Fran never says this. The quote page shows her real lines ('A life lived in fear is a life half lived'). Doug's real line is 'Shall we dance?'
No Federation dinner dance appears in the plot or the quote page. Fife runs the Pan Pacific championship.

facts.text: Ya Ya's rhythm, felt from the heart.
facts.why: Ya Ya and Rico demonstrate the paso doble in the plot, but no opened source has her saying anything about rhythm felt from the heart.
facts.fix: Ya Ya and Rico teach the real paso doble.

vibe.verdict: The red poster looks the part but the prom layout and generic canapés miss the film's loud Federation fights and Fran's family.

Doug's secret footage in the studio back room

Replace the 'Cold horchata with cinnamon' note with Fran's 'Vivir con miedo' paso doble line from the backstage fight.
